newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzanian shilling weakens on dollar, pound.
newsitem.headline: Tanzanian shilling weakens on dollar, pound.

text.p: The Tanzanian shilling fell against the dollar and pound on Friday, continuing a trend seen in the past three weeks, central bank dealers said.
The shilling was posted at a commercial mean rate of 597.7620 against the dollar compared to 597.6135 on Thursday and 597.3666 on Friday last week.
Against the pound, the shilling was posted at a mean rate of 975.0404 compared to 970.0776 on Thursday. The pound/shilling rate was 1,002.9805 on Friday last week.
"The market has been quiet for the whole week. It's hard to explain why the shilling is depreciating," said an official from the central Bank of Tanzania.
